thread:
Maya: Quick experiment 1 I want to capture 'micro-cards' from support notes + onboarding calls so PMs get a steady daily queue. Short, actionable, and triage-ready. Target: 10 cards/day. Deadline EOD Tue for this batch.

```
Customer: [name]
Pain (1 line): what breaks / manual work
Ask (1 line): feature or behavior change
Impact (1 line): ops / renewal / revenue / time saved
Priority: P0 / P1 / P2
Reporter + source: ticket / call + date
Attachments: recording / CSV / screenshot / minimal repro
Action owner: CS / PM / Eng
```

Priya: Love this. I'll paste 6 from last week's tickets. Will add a short CSV example where applicable.

Ibrahim (Support): Can the Support Bot auto-fill fields from ticket metadata? Suggest adding a small "confidence" note when we auto-extract.

Support Bot: Auto-scan enabled for ticket subjects containing "invoice" "cost" "embed". It will create draft cards (tagged draft-auto) for review.

Elena (PM): Please tag any mention of churn/renewal with [RENEWAL-RISK]. Also include a rough revenue-at-risk bucket if known (e.g., <$10k, $10k-100k, >$100k). P0 = blocking renewals or production break.

Maya: Also: for model-behavior asks, include a minimal failing prompt or sample input/expected output (one-liner) so NLP engineers can repro. If customers can't record, CS should note steps and sample text.

Priya: Adding sample micro-card now:
Priya: Card -> Customer: Nimbus Health | Pain: extracted invoice IDs sometimes include stray characters after long context (>6k tokens) | Ask: improve invoice extraction heuristics or expose field-mapping API | Impact: manual cleanup ~3hrs/week; support queue spikes; renewal mention on Q3 check-in | Priority: P0 [RENEWAL-RISK] | Reporter: ticket #2345 (4/12) | Attachments: https://loom/recap / csv sample attached | Action owner: Eng - NLP

Ibrahim (Support): Card -> Customer: GardenOps | Pain: per-route billing visibility missing for team-level chargebacks | Ask: per-route cost export (CSV) + API filter by team | Impact: finance can't allocate cost, renewal discussion paused | Priority: P1 | Reporter: onboarding call 4/9 | Attachments: example billing rows in CSV | Action owner: PM + Eng

Maya: Great examples. If you're unsure on priority, mark P2 and tag @Elena for review. We'll triage P0s in tomorrow's PM sync and pull hot ones into the next sprint.

Priya: A couple of enablement asks too (put as cards but label ENABL): "How to surface model hallucination vs prompt bug" and "Script for asking about embeddings freshness". Those are CS playbook items but useful to have in queue.

Elena (PM): Well review top 15 cards on Fri triage. P0s go to hotfix backlog; P1s are candidate features; P2s are backlog grooming.

Maya: Closing loop 1 EOD Tue is hard deadline for this run. If partial, mark as draft and note missing fields so PM can follow up. Thanks team :raised_hands:

Support Bot: Reminder: Draft cards saved to sheet https://sheet.link/microcards. Use card id when you link tickets.
